Leading AI models usually attempt dangerous tasks rather than refuse them when controlling a robot, according to the RoboHarm benchmark. Google and Deepmind's Dream-RSI lets AI agents "dream" through past search runs to test new strategies without costly recalculations. ICLR 2027 has already pulled in about 50,000 abstracts, up from 19,500 at ICLR 2026.
